physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Second untried candidate: keep the baseline physical settings and enable only the protocol-proved exact signed 18-bit reduction with 32-bit sign extension and unchanged cycle contract. Complete captured context, route, review and evaluation records were inspected. Candidate 1 enabled both actions at these settings: cell_area_um2=160081 versus baseline 161954 (1.16% smaller), die_area_um2=374764, setup_slack_ns=-0.0262439, hold_slack_ns=0.0945523, and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations. It was physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false, with failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing]; energy_j and estimated_power_w were empty, so no qualified Q or energy improvement exists. Its physical cost was 3516.572450898995 s; no postprocessing commands ran. Disabling operand isolation removes masking gates and their possible delay while retaining the width-reduction area/capacitance opportunity. The failed report does not identify the critical path, so timing recovery and area/energy gains remain hypotheses; changed placement can dominate, and isolation switching savings are forfeited. Preserve utilization=40, density=0.55, abc_area=0 and repair_margin=0 to isolate this action change and avoid speculative mapping or placement changes. Baseline remains the qualified incumbent with Q=1, setup/hold slack=0.19292/0.114491 ns. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6), subject to full physical and measurement qualification at frozen period 10526 ps. Die area alone earns no score. The protected evaluation must report configuration, rtl_actions, cell/die area, setup/hold slack, electrical_violations, failure_classes, physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, all three workload energies and powers, activity/parasitic annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, manifests and execution costs. Retain failed measurements and costs and the best qualified result. This requests one next evaluation after one accepted new candidate, within the three-candidate cap; EDA wait is separate from the common 1200-second agent budget. Energy evidence remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, without SDF/glitch or silicon-power claims; no new PPA outcome is asserted.
